browser_smoke_plan: navigate to http://localhost:{port}/ — the Ingest page, the persistent model-limits disclosure and, on an empty database, the demo-seed button (data-testid=demo-seed)
click demo-seed; expect a source row badged 'demo · synthetic' whose state becomes ready (poll until the ingest job completes, <= 300 s)
open Triage; expect a candidate whose data-testid=candidate-explanation names "this recording's p85" and a stationary_animal_with_person candidate whose evidence is marked synthetic
press v on the first candidate; expect the source-resolution pane to open and stream the original file
press a to accept (reviewer name and a source-viewed indicator appear); press f, type a note, press Enter, reload the page and expect the note to persist

click Export with default settings and wait for the download; expect a ZIP containing manifest.json, manifest.canonical, manifest.sig, public.pem, candidates.csv, clips/, ledger.jsonl, checksums.sha256, verify_bundle.py, ed25519_verifier.py, VERIFY.md and README.txt
